args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Fix `parseAmount` so that thousands separators (periods in European formats like "12.500" or commas in standard formats) are correctly handled when parsing amounts, rather than treating them as decimal points. This ensures zero-decimal currencies like Chilean pesos (CLP) parse correctly without being scaled down by a factor of a thousand.
args.title: Fix amount parsing for numbers containing thousands separators

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`parseAmount` in `src/util/money.ts` strips commas but doesn't handle period thousands separators correctly (e.g. "12.500" parsed as 12.5 instead of 12500), causing zero-decimal currencies like Chilean pesos to be parsed and formatted incorrectly.
